scandit_configuration: configs/scandit_all_supported.json - SC_PRESET_HIGH_EFFORT, multi-scan enabled, color-inverted enabled, full-image search, new frame sequence per image
scandit_license: Linux trial key with network activation; tracking feature available
timing_caveat: Four worker processes shared the 16 logical processors, so decode timings include CPU contention. Compare readers only within this run; do not compare absolute times with the earlier single-process Windows measurement.
known_issues: 6 dynamsoft-dbr frames returned 'Operation timeout' and are recorded as decoder_error. Every record was re-scored with scoring protocol v2: the underscored BarBeR labels map to the names the readers use, GS1 application identifiers in parentheses are unwrapped for Code 128, a Royal Mail payload one character shorter than the annotation counts as the same reading, and CODE_128 / GS1_128 are matched as one format family. No decoder was re-run and no decode time changed.
notes: All three decoders were measured in the same container, in one process per slice, on the same RGB888 pixel buffer for every image. The Linux DCV build resolves models relative to its link directory, so a private SDK copy with Models/ beside the libraries is staged inside the container.
